first_round_summary_timing.units: seconds; measured requests only, warmups excluded
first_round_summary_timing.total: answer call or topic detection; excludes model load, setup, evidence checks and report export
first_round_summary_timing.faq: entire measured FAQ matching call for A1/A2, including query embedding; no LLM generation
first_round_summary_timing.rag: measured document retrieval plus reranking when separately measured; excludes Prompt construction
first_round_summary_timing.llm: synchronized model.generate call only; excludes text decoding and Prompt construction
first_round_summary_timing.unused_or_unmeasured: blank, not a fabricated zero; Cache Hits do not inherit origin generation time
first_round_summary_timing.sd_total: controlled sum of once-measured shared preparation and mode execution; labelled in category
first_round_summary_timing.ti: total is detection cost, not an answer-generation latency; attention prefill is not generation
first_round_summary_timing.order: one CSV row per measured attempt, no averaging; IDs, repeats and failures remain in detailed JSONL

timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized answer call; excludes load, initialization, hashing and export
